summary: GrowHub Ltd (Cayman Islands) filed a Form 6-K furnishing notices and proxy materials for three back-to-back extraordinary general meetings (EGMs) scheduled for August 5, 2026. The EGMs seek shareholder approval to adopt an amended and restated memorandum and articles of association, contingent upon an increase in share capital and requisite class consents. The board unanimously recommends a vote in favor. No specific transaction, acquisition, divestiture, or other special-situation event is disclosed; the filing is a routine proxy solicitation for corporate governance matters, not triggering any special-situation classification.
